主要内容: Nicholas Financial Inc held its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on August 12, 2014. The voting results for the election of directors were as follows: Ralph Finkenbrink received 6,239,460 votes, Kevin Bates received 5,865,324 votes, and Stephen Bragin received 4,520,333 votes. The directors whose terms continued after the meeting were Scott Fink and Alton R. Neal.
